population_one_line: Adult inpatients with fungemia (yeast), community teaching hospital, USA
notes: Conference abstract (IDWeek/OFID 2020 poster) - descriptive only; reports TTP and outcomes but no quantitative TTP↔outcome association.

population_one_line: Adult candidemia/invasive candidiasis at large community hospital, USA
ttp_reported: Time to detection: T2CP 9h (IQR 6-17) vs BC 41h (IQR 29-60); p<0.001
outcome_one_line: 30-day mortality 37.1% vs 31.3% (p=0.351); no TTP-mortality association reported
notes: BC system comparison study (T2 Candida Panel vs BC). Time-to-detection compared between methods, not analyzed as a continuous predictor of outcome. Multivariate mortality model includes renal failure/CCI/age, not TTP.

population_one_line: Adults with MSSA bacteremia treated with ASP or cefazolin, Mayo Clinic
outcome_one_line: Failure to clear BCx within 72h - associated with hypoalbuminemia (37% vs 10.2%)
notes: Conference abstract; exposure is hypoalbuminemia, outcome is blood culture clearance. TTP not measured/analyzed.

population_one_line: Narrative review on CLABSI and primary BSI in ICU
ttp_reported: Mentions differential TTP for CRBSI diagnosis (narrative)
notes: Narrative review/Current Opinion article. No original quantitative TTP↔outcome analysis.

population_one_line: Adults with Staphylococcus aureus bacteremia, single tertiary center, Stockholm 2011-2021
ttp_reported: Median TTP 13h (IQR 10-18); cutpoint at median (13h); analyzed continuously and by quartiles
outcome_one_line: Endocarditis (9%): TTP <13h independent OR 3.59 (95% CI 2.35-5.3); per-hour OR 0.89 (0.54-0.92); NPV 96% for TTP>13h
notes: Primary outcome is IE (not mortality), but quantitative TTP↔outcome association is clearly reported. Large cohort, multivariable analysis. Strong include.

population_one_line: Correspondence/Letter to the Editor (CID) on Stromdahl 2025 SAB-TTP-IE article
ttp_reported: Discusses TTP results from prior cohort; no new primary analysis
notes: This file contains correspondence letters (Santos-Patarroyo et al letter + Stromdahl reply) re: the Stromdahl2025 paper. No new original analysis; duplicate discussion of Stromdahl2025 findings.

population_one_line: Adults with VRE faecium bacteremia (no endocarditis), treated with daptomycin vs linezolid, Detroit
ttp_reported: Not reported; reports duration of bacteremia (3.6 vs 2.6 days)
notes: TTP (time to BC positivity) not measured. Duration of bacteremia (time to clearance) is the temporal measure - different concept.

population_one_line: Adults with Streptococcus agalactiae bacteraemia, southern Sweden, 2016-2023
ttp_reported: Median TTP 9.0h overall (n=411 for TTP analysis)
outcome_one_line: 30-day mortality: TTP 8.6h vs 9.1h (p=0.4); IE: TTP 7.5h vs 9.1h (p=0.005)
notes: Quantitative TTP↔outcome comparisons reported (TTP medians/IQRs by outcome status with p-values). Negative for mortality but significant for IE.

population_one_line: Lab process study of BC turnaround times across 13 US acute care hospitals
ttp_reported: TAT for Gram stain/ID/AST reported by organism
notes: Microbiology/lab workflow paper. Reports lab turnaround times by organism but no patient-level clinical outcomes (mortality, persistent bacteremia, etc.).

population_one_line: Mold-positive blood cultures (Fusarium, Lomentospora, etc.), French RESSIF surveillance 2012-2022
ttp_reported: Median 72h (IQR 52.3-90); 38.4h for Mucorales; described by genus only
outcome_one_line: 90-day mortality 53%; Firth logistic regression on mortality (mold species, corticosteroids, organ involvement) - TTP not in model
notes: TTP described descriptively by mold genus but not analyzed as a predictor of mortality. Multivariable model omits TTP. Descriptive-only TTP reporting.
